subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo & looping in security/procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finpath.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finpath.com>
Cc: david.kim@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo & looping in security/procurement

Hi Alex & Samantha —

Great to chat this morning — thanks for the time. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- What we heard: FinPath is evaluating an LLM inference platform to (1) reduce per-token cost on customer-facing chat, (2) standardize inference across cloud regions, and (3) satisfy security/compliance needs (SOC 2, audit trail, VPC).
- Key constraints: procurement timeline ~June renewal, security needs SOC2 evidence + network diagram review, prefer a technical deep dive with your platform/infra team to validate latency and integration approach.

Suggested next steps: 
1) 30-45m technical demo / deep dive where David (our Solutions Eng) can walk through architecture, runtimes, and integration patterns.
2) Loop in your security & procurement folks on a 30m call to review SOC2 summary and procurement steps.

Proposed demo slots (all PT):
- Tue 16 Mar — 10:00-10:45am PT
- Wed 17 Mar — 2:00-2:45pm PT
- Thu 18 Mar — 11:00-11:45am PT

If those don't work, you can pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-co/30min

I've attached a short SOC 2 summary (Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf) for Ryan/your security team to review ahead of time. I'll follow up to loop in David and our security engineer for the technical session once you confirm which slot you prefer.

Thanks — happy to align across teams.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finpath.com>, Ryan Chen <ryan.chen@finpath.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.n@finpath.com>, procurement@finpath.com
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo & looping in security/procurement

Thanks Marissa — useful recap.

We're interested in the technical deep dive. Please include someone from your tech team who can speak to latency for 1-2k concurrent users and the KV cache behavior.

I'll bring in our security and procurement contacts: Ryan Chen (sec) and Priya Natarajan (procurement). Ryan — Priya — Marissa is from Redwood and will send the SOC2 summary; Marissa, CC'd below are the right folks on our side.

Of the slots above, Tue 16 Mar 10:00am PT works best for me. Can you confirm? If David can do it then that would be ideal.

Cc: david.kim@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com, Ryan Chen <ryan.chen@finpath.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.n@finpath.com>, procurement@finpath.com
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo & looping in security/procurement

Thanks Alex — Tue 16 Mar 10:00am PT is perfect. Confirming slot and looping in David + Dev from our side:

- David Kim (david.kim@redwood.com) — Solutions Engineer, will lead the technical demo and cover latency/throughput/KV cache behavior.
- Dev Patel (dev.patel@redwood.com) — Security Engineer, will be on hand for SOC2/network questions.

Draft agenda for the demo (30-45m):
- 5m quick product recap + goals
- 20m technical demo (runtime, batching, quantization options, KV cache behavior)
- 10m security & integration Q&A
- 5-10m next steps / MAP review

I've attached a short mutual action plan (Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx) with proposed owners and timelines so procurement can take a look before your meeting. Ryan/Priya — please flag any items that need to be moved earlier for your timeline.

Calendar invite to follow once I get confirmation from David on attendees — but consider Tue 16 Mar 10:00-10:45am PT tentatively booked.

Best —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx

From: Ryan Chen <ryan.chen@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@finpath.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.n@finpath.com>, procurement@finpath.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo & looping in security/procurement

Marissa / Alex — thanks for the SOC2 summary. A couple quick asks from security so we can be prepared for the call: 

1) Can you share the full SOC 2 report (or a redacted version) and a network diagram (eg VPC peering / egress patterns)? If a redacted report isn't available, the SOC2 summary is a good start but we'll need more detail before an audit.
2) Do you have an architecture slide that shows where the inference runtime sits (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and the data flow for customer prompts / logs?

On availability: Tue 16 Mar 10:00am PT works for me for the initial technical session. Procurement will likely want a separate 30m to go over terms — Priya, can you coordinate with procurement@finpath.com on availability?

Thanks — we'll plan to review the SOC2 doc ahead of the call.

Ryan Chen
Security Architect, FinPath
ryan.chen@finpath.com
